SELECT st.id, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.name, st.gender, st.phone, st.email, st.class_id AS classId, cl.class_name AS className, c.college_name AS collegeName, st.enroll_year AS enrollYear, u.username, u.status, st.create_time AS createTime FROM t_student st JOIN t_class cl ON cl.id = st.class_id LEFT JOIN t_college c ON c.id = cl.college_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.ref_id = st.id AND u.user_type = 'STUDENT'
AND (st.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR st.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND st.class_id = #{classId}
ORDER BY st.id
